name: Prelate Obby Windlestraw
bio: Priest of the Prince of Evil Air and leader of the Hush Concord. A very old gnome who hovers on his own updraft and flicks a lace handkerchief before he speaks. Breaks off at 13 hp or fewer, or when a camera turns on him.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.desc: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Wind Veil
traits.desc: Ranged attack rolls against Obby have disadvantage while he is conscious and unrestrained.

traits.name: Held Breath
traits.desc: Obby does not need to breathe. Stolen Breath and Pocket Calm effects do not impair him.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Obby makes two Gale Lance attacks.

actions.name: Gale Lance
actions.desc: Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet.

actions.name: Stolen Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: 30-foot cone. Each creature makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. Fail: 22 (5d8) force damage and the creature cannot speak or cast spells with verbal components until the end of its next turn. Success: half damage only.

actions.name: Pocket Calm (1/Day)
actions.desc: A 20-foot-radius sphere centred on a point within 60 feet goes completely still and silent for 1 minute (concentration). No sound passes in or out, gas and smoke are dispelled, and non-magical flame inside it goes out. No spoken spells inside.

reactions.name: Exhale
reactions.desc: When a creature within 5 feet hits him with a melee attack, it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw or is pushed 10 feet.
